title: Crayola Magnetic Blocks Are Recalled Over Choking Hazard Concerns
content: Magnets in the toy, pip-Cubes, can fall out of the blocks and be swallowed by children, causing injury or death, federal regulators warned.

title: Scott Bessent on Tariffs, the Fed and the Economy

title: What to Know About Netflix’s $83 Billion Deal for Warner Bros. Discovery
content: The cash-and-stock deal would give the world’s largest paid streaming service expansive power over theater owners and entertainment-industry unions.

title: Angst Turns to Anger in Hollywood as Netflix Hooks Warner Bros.
content: Much of the entertainment capital fears that Netflix’s deal will lead to more job losses and theater closings and fewer boundary-pushing movies.

title: Trump Accounts, Baby Bonds: Giving Directly to Kids Is an Idea Right and Left Could Love
content: Michael and Susan Dell’s $6.25 billion donation to child savings accounts fits a trend: giving with no strings attached. In some ways, it’s a bipartisan philosophy.

title: Have Trump’s Tariffs Gone as High as They Can Go? Businesses Hope So
content: A wave of companies are petitioning for exemptions from the Trump administration’s high levies on foreign-made goods, saying they are hurting business and raising prices.

title: Don’t Call It a Pivot. These Executives Are ‘Refounding’ Their Start-Ups.
content: In the age of artificial intelligence, some company leaders are framing new business lines as radical reboots.

title: Survivors of the Deadly Hong Kong Fire Are in Limbo
content: Hong Kong, with some of the world’s highest housing costs and inequality, must now figure out how to help thousands of residents who lost friends, family and homes.

title: Chuck Kesey, Probiotic Yogurt Pioneer, Dies at 87
content: The younger brother of Ken Kesey, the novelist and counterculture luminary, he turned a defunct creamery into what is now Nancy’s Probiotic Foods.

title: Olivia Nuzzi and Vanity Fair Will Part Ways
content: Condé Nast, the magazine’s parent company, said her contract would expire at the end of the year.

title: Lots of Oil, Little Production: What to Know About Venezuelan Energy

title: Netflix Changes Course Again With Warner Bros. Deal

title: CNN Is Excluded From Netflix’s Warner Bros. Deal for Now
